data.title: 令 · 月下水榭的醉龙长吟
data.action: 侧倚在雕花木栏杆边，单手斜拎着白瓷酒盏，青丝任由夜风拂乱，龙角在月下泛着温润微光，醉眼迷离笑看人间，尽显洒脱不羁的风流意趣。
data.location: 江南水乡湖心古亭，池中荷叶微卷，月光倒映在荡漾水面上
data.lighting: 清冷皎洁的浩大满月洒下万顷银霜，与亭角一盏昏红风灯形成诗意映衬
data.mood: 豪迈豁达、飘逸如仙的国风醉意与旷达浪漫
data.description: 江南水乡湖心古亭，池中荷叶微卷，月光倒映在荡漾水面上。侧倚在雕花木栏杆边，单手斜拎着白瓷酒盏，青丝任由夜风拂乱，龙角在月下泛着温润微光，醉眼迷离笑看人间，尽显洒脱不羁的风流意趣。 她微微抬眸轻语——“今朝有酒今朝醉……小家伙，这良辰美景皆在盏中，何不卸下心防，与我同醉一场？”
data.promptProse: Leaning effortlessly against the carved timber railing of a lakeside pavilion on a full-moon night, Ling wears a billowing celadon-green silk open robe draped over an embroidered jade-teal bandeau. Lifting a delicate white porcelain wine cup in one hand as night breeze tosses her long hair, she smiles with poetic, slightly tipsy ease while silver moonlight floods the lotus pond beside the pavilion's warm red lantern.
data.animaCaption: Leaning against the carved pavilion railing in her open celadon silk robe and jade embroidered bandeau, Ling raises a white porcelain wine cup with a poetic, tipsy smile. Bright full moonlight silvers the lotus pond beside a warm red pavilion lantern.
data.nsfwProse: She wears a flowing celadon-green wide-sleeved silk robe parted open in front over a jade-teal embroidered bandeau bra, exposing her pale collarbone and graceful curves.
